scripts.prepare-gh-pages: rm -rf dist-gh && mkdir dist-gh && cp -r dist/apps/main-host/* dist-gh/ && mkdir -p dist-gh/mf_remote_a && cp -r dist/apps/mf_remote_a/* dist-gh/mf_remote_a/ && mkdir -p dist-gh/mf_remote_b && cp -r dist/apps/mf_remote_b/* dist-gh/mf_remote_b/ && mkdir -p dist-gh/mf_remote_home && cp -r dist/apps/mf_remote_home/* dist-gh/mf_remote_home/ && cp apps/main-host/public/module-federation.manifest.gh-pages.json dist-gh/module-federation.manifest.json && touch dist-gh/.nojekyll
scripts.ghBuildProd:all: pnpm run build:common-ui-lib:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-a:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-b:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-home:prod && NX_MF_GH_PAGES_BUILD=true pnpm run build:main-host:prod
scripts.ghBuildProd:shell: pnpm run build:common-ui-lib:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-a:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-b:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-home:prod && NX_MF_GH_PAGES_BUILD=true pnpm run build:main-host:prod
scripts.ghBuildProd:mf-remote-a: pnpm run build:common-ui-lib:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-a:prod
scripts.ghBuildProd:mf-remote-b: pnpm run build:common-ui-lib:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-b:prod
scripts.ghBuildProd:mf-remote-home: pnpm run build:common-ui-lib:prod && pnpm run build:mf-remote-home:prod
scripts.ghDeploy:all: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t
scripts.ghDeploy:shell: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t
scripts.ghDeploy:mf-remote-a: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t
scripts.ghDeploy:mf-remote-b: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t
scripts.ghDeploy:mf-remote-home: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t
scripts.ghDeploy:all:force: pnpm run prepare-gh-pages && gh-pages -d dist-gh -b gh-pages -t --force
